Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
-R . ""

# 176 — roDOT with pure methods: side-effect freedom

## Task

Show that a well-typed roDOT call satisfying the side-effect-free premises leaves pre-existing heap objects unchanged while the call is still executing.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `SefG_I`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: TLC.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

Fixpoint ctx_kdom(vk: varkind)(c: ctx): fset var :=
match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Definition ctx_k G v vk:=
  exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2.

Notation subst_ctx x y := (ctx_map (subst_var x y)).

Notation "G '/[§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_vars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Notation "G '/[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_vars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_pvars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_pvars xs ys)).

Notation "G '//[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_pvars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_seal_rec n x G :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_stop G => ctx_stop (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_hide G => ctx_hide (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_push G y vk t => ctx_push (ctx_seal_rec n x G) y vk (seal_rec n x t)
  end.

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=
| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v vk t) v
| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_vis G v ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v2 vk t) v
.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive mode :=
  | basic
  | basic_no_fun
  | basic_incap
  | basic_sef_typing
  | rodot
  | rodot_top_nm
  | rodot_nm_compl
  | rodot_nm_muttop
  | rodot_nm_compl_muttop
  | rodot_sef.

Class Mode := mode_m: mode.

Definition mode_has_fun' m: bool := match m with
| basic | basic_sef_typing => true
| _ => false
end.

Notation mode_has_fun m := ((mode_has_fun' m) = true)(only parsing).

Definition mode_has_mutability' m: bool := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => true
| _ => false
end.

Notation mode_has_mutability m := ((mode_has_mutability' m) = true)(only parsing).

Inductive mode_visibility := mode_visibility_all | mode_visibility_hide_method.

Definition mode_visibility' m: mode_visibility := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_visibility_hide_method
| _ => mode_visibility_all
end.

Notation mode_has_visibility m := ((mode_visibility' m) = mode_visibility_hide_method)(only parsing).

Inductive mode_refcaps := mode_refcaps_none | mode_refcaps_mutability.

Definition mode_refcaps' m: mode_refcaps := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_refcaps_mutability
| _ => mode_refcaps_none
end.

Inductive mode_refcap_corr := mode_refcap_corr_same | mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability.

Definition mode_refcap_corr' m: mode_refcap_corr := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop  | rodot_sef => mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability
| _ => mode_refcap_corr_same
end.

Inductive mode_viewpoint_adaptation := mode_viewpoint_adaptation_same | mode_viewpoint_adapt_mutability.

Definition mode_viewpoint_adaptation' m: mode_viewpoint_adaptation := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_viewpoint_adapt_mutability
| _ => mode_viewpoint_adaptation_same
end.

Inductive mode_objlit_refcaps := mode_objlit_refcaps_none | mode_objlit_refcaps_mutable.

Definition mode_objlit_refcaps' m: mode_objlit_refcaps := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_objlit_refcaps_mutable
| _ => mode_objlit_refcaps_none
end.

Inductive mode_top_nm := mode_top_nm_none | mode_top_nm_subtype | mode_top_nm_complement.

Definition mode_top_nm' m: mode_top_nm := match m with
| rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_top_nm_subtype
| rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop  => mode_top_nm_complement
| _ => mode_top_nm_none
end.

Definition mode_has_top_nm_subtype' m: bool := match (mode_top_nm' m) with
| mode_top_nm_subtype | mode_top_nm_complement => true
| _ => false
end.

Notation mode_has_top_nm_subtype m := ((mode_has_top_nm_subtype' m) = true)(only parsing).

Notation mode_has_top_nm_complement m := ((mode_top_nm' m) = mode_top_nm_complement)(only parsing).

Notation mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless m := ((mode_top_nm' m) = mode_top_nm_subtype)(only parsing).

Inductive mode_mut_top := mode_mut_top_none | mode_mut_top_subtype.

Definition mode_mut_top' m: mode_mut_top := match m with
| rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop => mode_mut_top_subtype
| _ => mode_mut_top_none
end.

Notation mode_has_mut_top m := ((mode_mut_top' m) = mode_mut_top_subtype)(only parsing).

Inductive mode_incap := mode_incap_none | mode_incap_structural | mode_incap_nocap.

Definition mode_incap' m: mode_incap := match m with
| basic_incap | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_incap_nocap
| rodot => mode_incap_structural
| _ => mode_incap_none
end.

Definition mode_has_incap' m: bool := match (mode_incap' m) with
| mode_incap_none => false
| _ => true
end.

Notation mode_has_incap m := ((mode_has_incap' m) = true)(only parsing).

Inductive mode_ty_inv := mode_ty_inv_flat | mode_ty_inv_layered.

Definition mode_ty_inv' m: mode_ty_inv := match m with
| basic_incap | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_ty_inv_layered
| _ => mode_ty_inv_flat
end.

Inductive mode_sef := mode_sef_none | mode_sef_guarantee.

Definition mode_sef' m : mode_sef := match m with
| rodot_sef |  rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop  | basic_sef_typing => mode_sef_guarantee
| _ => mode_sef_none
end.

Notation mode_has_sef m := ((mode_sef' m) = mode_sef_guarantee)(only parsing).
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Equivalence Indep.

Require Export TypingMode TypingContext.

Notation EnvProperty A B := (forall (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Notation TypingProperty A B := (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := obj_dec_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (obj_dec_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := obj_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (obj_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation typing G e a t := (obj_typing G objctx_empty e a t).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation dec_typing G e a d := (obj_dec_typing G objctx_empty e a d).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (dec_typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '⁏' e '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyping G objctx_empty e T U) (at level 40, e at level 39, T at level 59).

Class ReferenceIncapacitate := obj_ref_incap :
                                 ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" := (obj_ref_incap G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation ref_incap G e T1 T2 := (obj_ref_incap G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" :=
  (ref_incap G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Class CapabilityBound (C : typ_refcap_label) :=
  obj_cap_bnd :
     ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧  T2" := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation cap_bnd C G e T1 T2 := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧ T2" := (cap_bnd C G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap := (
  typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap
    (typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))
  )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)
      <: typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with ty_incap : ReferenceIncapacitate :=

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
     ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
     ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶icp T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'

| ty_incap_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T

| ty_incap_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2

| ty_incap_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T
.

Global Existing Instance ty_var.

Global Existing Instance subtyp.

Global Existing Instance ty_incap.

Inductive ty_capbnd (C : typ_refcap_label) : CapabilityBound C :=
| ty_capbnd_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_bot

| ty_capbnd_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_cap_sel G e S T:

    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T

| ty_capbnd_cap_ignore G e C' S T:
    C' <> C ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C') S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons f st)
.

Existing Instance tfree_trm.

Existing Instance tfree_lit.

Existing Instance tfree_def.

Existing Instance tfree_defs.

Existing Instance tfree_stack.

Definition all_tfree_k {A: Set} {AT: TFree A} G (t:A) vk :=
  forall v, tfree v t -> ctx_k G v vk.

Notation all_tfree_k_trm := (@all_tfree_k trm _).

Notation all_tfree_k_def := (@all_tfree_k def _).

Notation all_tfree_k_defs := (@all_tfree_k defs _).

Notation all_tfree_k_stack := (@all_tfree_k stack _).

Definition TFreeInFV (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AF: FreeVar A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    v \in fv t.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInvInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x tR,
      t = (open_rec k x tR) ->
      tfree v tR \/ v = x.

Class TFreeOpenInv(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open_inv v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v (open_rec n x t) ->
    tfree v t \/ v = x
.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x,
    tfree v (open_rec k x t).

Class TFreeOpen(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v t ->
    tfree v (open_rec n x t).

Section TFreeOpenLemmata.

Context (A: Set) {AT: TFree A} {AO: Openable A} {ATO: TFreeOpenInv AT}.

End TFreeOpenLemmata.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_write x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_call x m y => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_obj T ds => (fv T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  end with
fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (fv v)
  | def_met _ t     => (fv_trm t)
  end with
fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Instance DefsFreeVar : FreeVar defs := fv_defs.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: var) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var x        => trm_var (subst_var z u x)
  | trm_read x1 L     => trm_read (subst_var z u x1) L
  | trm_apply x1 x2    => trm_apply (subst_var z u x1) (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => trm_lit (subst_lit z u l) (subst_trm z u t)
  | trm_write x1 L x2  => trm_write (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_call x1 L x2  => trm_call (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  end with
subst_lit (z: var) (u: var) (l: lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t   => lit_fun (subst_var z u T) (subst_trm z u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj (subst_var z u T)
            (subst_defs z u ds)
  end with
subst_def (z: var) (u: var) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ l t => def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | def_fld l v => def_fld l (subst_var z u v)
  | def_met l t => def_met l (subst_trm z u t)
  end with
subst_defs (z: var) (u: var) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end.

Instance TrmSubstVar : SubstVar trm := subst_trm.

Instance LitSubstVar : SubstVar lit := subst_lit.

Instance DefSubstVar : SubstVar def := subst_def.

Instance DefsSubstVar : SubstVar defs := subst_defs.

Fixpoint seal_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (seal_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (seal_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (seal_rec k u f) (seal_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (seal_rec_trm k u t1) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (seal_rec_lit k u l) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (seal_rec k u v) m (seal_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (seal_rec k u v) m (seal_rec k u v2)
  end with
seal_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (seal_rec k u T) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>

      (seal_rec (S k) u T)
      (seal_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
seal_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=

  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (seal_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (seal_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (seal_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with

Instance LitSealable : Sealable lit := seal_rec_lit.

Instance LitAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax LitOpenable LitFreeVar LitSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefOpenable DefFreeVar DefSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefsOpenable DefsFreeVar DefsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefLabelOf : LabelOf def :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | def_fld m _ => label_fld m
      | def_met m _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a       => (f a)
  | trm_read x m      => (f x)
  | trm_apply f' a      => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t)
  | trm_write x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_call x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)
  | lit_obj T ds => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_defs df f comb ds)
  end with
collect_def {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (d: def) : C :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (collect df f comb T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (f v)
  | def_met _ t     => (collect_trm df f comb t)
  end with
collect_defs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (ds : defs) : C  :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => df
  | defs_cons tl d   => comb (collect_defs df f comb tl) (collect_def df f comb d)
  end.

Instance TrmCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_trm.

Instance LitCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_lit.

Instance DefCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_def.

Instance DefsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_defs.

Fixpoint transform_trm (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (t : trm) (n : nat) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (f a n)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (f v n) m
  | trm_apply f' a    => trm_apply (f f' n) (f a n)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (transform_trm f t1 n) (transform_trm f t2 (S n))
  | trm_lit l t    => trm_lit (transform_lit f l n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  end with
transform_lit (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (l : lit) (n : nat) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (transform f T n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (transform f T (S n))
      (transform_defs f ds (S n))
  end with
transform_def (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (d : def) (n : nat) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (transform f T (S n))
  | def_fld m e => def_fld m (f e n)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (transform_trm f e (S (S n)))
  end with
transform_defs (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (ds : defs) (n : nat) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (transform_defs f tl n) (transform_def f d n)
  end.

Instance TrmTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_trm.

Instance LitTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_lit.

Instance DefTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_def.

Instance DefsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_defs.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import HeapUpdate.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith.Wf_nat Lia.

Local Definition frame_result (base : stack) (c : config) : Prop :=
  config_stack c = base /\ exists x, config_trm c = trm_var (avar_f x).

Local Lemma stack_suffix_refl s : stack_suffix s s.
Proof. exists stack_nil. reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma stack_suffix_push s f s' :
  stack_suffix s s' -> stack_suffix s (stack_cons f s').
Proof.
  intros [p ->]. exists (stack_cons f p). reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma stack_suffix_pop s f s' :
  stack_suffix s (stack_cons f s') ->
  s = stack_cons f s' \/ stack_suffix s s'.
Proof.
  intros [p Hp]. destruct p.
  - left. symmetry. exact Hp.
  - right. inversion Hp. now exists p.
Qed.

Local Lemma frame_step s c c' :
  c ↦ c' ->
  stack_suffix s (config_stack c) ->
  frame_result s c \/ stack_suffix s (config_stack c').
Proof.
  intros Hstep Hsuffix.
  destruct Hstep; simpl in *; try (right; exact Hsuffix).
  - destruct (stack_suffix_pop Hsuffix) as [Heq | Htail].
    + left. split; [symmetry; exact Heq | exists x; reflexivity].
    + right. exact Htail.
  - right. now apply stack_suffix_push.
Qed.

Local Lemma reduction_frame_prefix c0 k c :
  c0 ⊣ k ↦* c ->
  (exists j c', j < k /\ c0 ⊣ j ↦* c' /\ frame_result (config_stack c0) c') \/
  stack_suffix (config_stack c0) (config_stack c).
Proof.
  intros Hred. induction Hred as [c0 | c0 c1 c2 k Hred IH Hstep].
  - right. apply stack_suffix_refl.
  - destruct IH as [[j [c' [Hj [Hreach Hresult]]]] | Hsuffix].
    + left. exists j, c'. split; [lia | now split].
    + destruct (frame_step Hstep Hsuffix) as [Hresult | Hnew].
      * left. exists k, c1. split; [lia | now split].
      * right. exact Hnew.
Qed.

(* The earliest return over all traces witnesses the universal stack condition. *)
Local Lemma frame_end_of_first_result c0 k c :
  c0 ⊣ k ↦* c ->
  frame_result (config_stack c0) c ->
  (forall j c', j < k -> c0 ⊣ j ↦* c' -> ~ frame_result (config_stack c0) c') ->
  frame_end_in c0 k c.
Proof.
  intros Hred [Hstack Hvar] Hfirst.
  split; [exact Hred |].
  split; [| now split].
  intros n cn Hn Hreach.
  destruct (reduction_frame_prefix Hreach) as [[j [cj [Hj [Hjreach Hresult]]]] | Hsuffix].
  - exfalso. apply (Hfirst j cj); [lia | exact Hjreach | exact Hresult].
  - exact Hsuffix.
Qed.

Local Lemma earliest_frame_end c0 k :
  (exists j c, j < k /\ c0 ⊣ j ↦* c /\ frame_result (config_stack c0) c) ->
  exists j c, frame_end_in c0 j c /\ j < k.
Proof.
  intros [j [c [Hjk [Hred Hresult]]]].
  revert c Hjk Hred Hresult.
  induction j using (well_founded_induction lt_wf).
  intros c Hjk Hred Hresult.
  destruct (classic (exists i ci, i < j /\ c0 ⊣ i ↦* ci /\ frame_result (config_stack c0) ci))

  - eapply H; [exact Hij | lia | exact Hreach | exact Hres].
  - exists j, c. split; [| exact Hjk].
    eapply frame_end_of_first_result; eauto.
    intros i ci Hil Hreach Hres.
    apply Hnone. exists i, ci. auto.
Qed.

  apply (Hno j cj); [lia | exact Hend].
Qed.

(* Allocation preserves old bindings because freshness includes the heap domain. *)
Local Lemma reduction_no_old_update original c c' :

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Reserved Notation "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2"
         (at level 40, n at level 41, C2 at level 39).

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)
      <: typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with ty_incap : ReferenceIncapacitate :=

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
     ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
     ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':

    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶icp T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'

| ty_incap_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T

| ty_incap_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:

    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2

    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T

Global Existing Instance subtyp.

Global Existing Instance ty_incap.

Inductive ty_capbnd (C : typ_refcap_label) : CapabilityBound C :=
| ty_capbnd_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_bot

| ty_capbnd_cap_ignore G e C' S T:

    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C') S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T'

| ty_capbnd_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_and S2 T2

| ty_capbnd_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_or S2 T2

| ty_capbnd_all G e S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

Inductive viewpoint_adapt_cap: typ_refcap_label -> var -> (TypingProperty typ typ) :=
| viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine C x G Go e T Tstrip Tcap:

    G§§Go⁏e ⊢ T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ Tcap ->

Definition viewpoint_adapt x G Go e Tf Tr :=
  match (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode) with

  | mode_viewpoint_adaptation_same => Tf = Tr

  | mode_viewpoint_adapt_mutability => viewpoint_adapt_cap typ_refcap_mutability x G Go e Tf Tr
  end.

End WithTypingMode.

Notation "G ⁏ e ⊢ x ▷⟦ C ⟧ T1 ⟶ T2" :=
  (viewpoint_adapt_cap _ C x G objctx_empty e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, x at level 59, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation "G ⁏ e ⊢ x ▷ T1 ⟶ T2" :=
  (viewpoint_adapt _ x G objctx_empty e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, x at level 59, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_objlit typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode) with

  | mode_objlit_refcaps_none => typ_and (typ_bnd T) typ_top

  | mode_objlit_refcaps_mutable => typ_and (typ_bnd T) (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_trm_var : forall G e x T,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G z ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun S T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ S ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_trm_read : forall G e x a S T U,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) ->

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping TFree
  ConfigTyping OperationalSemantics MethodCall HeapCorrespondence.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

Local Lemma tfree_open_forward :
  (forall v t, tfree_trm v t -> forall n x, tfree_trm v (open_rec n x t)) /\\
  (forall v l, tfree_lit v l -> forall n x, tfree_lit v (open_rec n x l)) /\\
  (forall v d, tfree_def v d -> forall n x, tfree_def v (open_rec n x d)) /\\
  (forall v ds, tfree_defs v ds -> forall n x, tfree_defs v (open_rec n x ds)).
Proof.
  apply tfree_mutind; intros; simpl; solve [constructor; auto].
Qed.

Local Lemma visible_in_pushed_context x G v vk T :
  ctx_vis (G § v / vk ~ T) x -> x = v \\/ ctx_vis G x.
Proof. inversion 1; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma visible_method_variable mode G Go z r TZ TC v :
  mode_has_visibility mode ->
  ctx_vis (ctx_obj_met mode G Go z TZ r TC) v ->
  v = z \\/ v = r.
Proof.
  intro Hmode. destruct Go; unfold ctx_obj_met; rewrite Hmode; intro H.
  all: destruct (visible_in_pushed_context H) as [-> | H']; [now right |].
  all: destruct (visible_in_pushed_context H') as [-> | H'']; [now left | inversion H''].
Qed.

Local Lemma visible_typed_variables mode :
  mode_has_visibility mode ->
  (forall G Go e t T, @ty_trm mode G Go e t T -> forall v, tfree_trm v t -> ctx_vis (G §§& Go) v) /\\
  (forall G Go e l T, @ty_lit mode G Go e l T -> forall v, tfree_lit v l -> ctx_vis (G §§& Go) v) /\\
  (forall G Go e d D, @ty_def mode G Go e d D -> forall v, tfree_def v d -> ctx_vis (G §§& Go) v) /\\
  (forall G Go e ds T, @ty_defs mode G Go e ds T -> forall v, tfree_defs v ds -> ctx_vis (G §§& Go) v).
Proof.
  intro Hmode.
  destruct tfree_open_forward as [Htrm [Hlit [Hdef Hdefs]]].
  apply rules_mutind; intros; simpl in *;
    match goal with
    | H : tfree_trm _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
    | H : tfree_lit _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
    | H : tfree_def _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
    | H : tfree_defs _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
    end;
    try solve [eauto].
  all: try match goal with
  | H : tfree_trm ?v ?t,
    IH : forall x, x \\notin ?L -> forall v, tfree_trm v (open x ?t) -> _ |- _ =>
    destruct (var_fresh (L \\u \\{v})) as [x Hfresh];
    apply notin_union in Hfresh as [Hx Hne];
    apply notin_singleton in Hne;
    specialize (IH x Hx v (Htrm v t H 0 x));
    destruct (visible_in_pushed_context IH) as [Heq | Hvis];
    [congruence | exact Hvis]
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | H : tfree_defs ?v ?ds,
    IH : forall x, x \\notin ?L -> forall v, tfree_defs v (open x ?ds) -> _ |- _ =>
    destruct (var_fresh (L \\u \\{v})) as [x Hfresh];
    apply notin_union in Hfresh as [Hx Hne];
    apply notin_singleton in Hne;
    specialize (IH x Hx v (Hdefs v ds H 0 x));
    destruct (visible_in_pushed_context IH) as [Heq | Hvis];
    [congruence | exact Hvis]
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | H : tfree_trm ?v ?t,
    IH : forall z, z \\notin ?L -> forall r, r <> z -> r \\notin ?L ->
      forall v, tfree_trm v (open_met z r ?t) -> _ |- _ =>
    destruct (var_fresh (L \\u \\{v})) as [z Hz];
    destruct (var_fresh ((L \\u \\{v}) \\u \\{z})) as [r Hr];
    apply notin_union in Hz as [HzL Hzn];
    apply notin_union in Hr as [Hr Hvz];
    apply notin_union in Hr as [HrL Hrn];
    apply notin_singleton in Hzn, Hrn, Hvz;
    specialize (IH z HzL r Hvz HrL v (Htrm _ _ (Htrm _ _ H 1 r) 0 z));
    destruct (visible_method_variable Hmode IH); congruence
  end.
Qed.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

Fixpoint ctx_collect_values(A: Set)(fn: typ -> fset A)(G: ctx): fset A :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_stop G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
end.

Notation ctx_fv := (ctx_collect_values fv).

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_binds_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v2 vk t2)
| ctx_binds_hide(v: var)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk t (ctx_push G v vk t) G
| ctx_binds_k_n(v v2: var)(vk1 vk2: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G1 G2: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

Fixpoint ctx_kdom(vk: varkind)(c: ctx): fset var :=
match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Definition ctx_k G v vk:=
  exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2.

Notation subst_ctx x y := (ctx_map (subst_var x y)).

Notation "G '/[§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_vars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Notation "G '/[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_vars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_pvars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_pvars xs ys)).

Notation "G '//[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_pvars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_seal_rec n x G :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_stop G => ctx_stop (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_hide G => ctx_hide (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_push G y vk t => ctx_push (ctx_seal_rec n x G) y vk (seal_rec n x t)
  end.

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=
| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v vk t) v
| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep.

Local Definition preserves_ctx_binds (G H : ctx) :=
  forall x T, ctx_binds x T G -> ctx_binds x T H.

Local Lemma preserves_ctx_binds_push G H x vk T :
  preserves_ctx_binds G H ->
  preserves_ctx_binds (G § x / vk ~ T) (H § x / vk ~ T).
Proof.
  intros Hkeep z U Hbind. inversion Hbind; subst.
  - constructor.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma var_equivalence_extend e e' x y :
  @tyq_var e x y ->
  env_binds_more e e' ->
  @tyq_var e' x y.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; intros Hmore.
  - apply tyq_var_refl.
  - apply tyq_var_binds. now apply Hmore.
  - now apply tyq_var_sym.
  - eapply tyq_var_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma typ_equivalence_extend e e' S T :
  @tyq_typ e S T ->
  env_binds_more e e' ->
  @tyq_typ e' S T.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; intro Hmore.
  - now apply tyq_typ_nulary.
  - now apply tyq_typ_andor.
  - now apply tyq_typ_fun.
  - now apply tyq_typ_fld.
  - now apply tyq_typ_typ.
  - apply tyq_typ_sel_normal. eapply var_equivalence_extend; eassumption.
  - apply tyq_typ_sel.
  - now apply tyq_typ_bnd.
  - now apply tyq_typ_met.
Qed.

Local Lemma variable_judgments_extend mode :
  (forall G Go e x T, @ty_var mode G Go e x T ->
    forall H e', preserves_ctx_binds G H -> env_binds_more e e' ->
    @ty_var mode H Go e' x T) /\\
  (forall G Go e S T, @subtyp mode G Go e S T ->
    forall H e', preserves_ctx_binds G H -> env_binds_more e e' ->
    @subtyp mode H Go e' S T) /\\
  (forall G Go e S T, @ty_incap mode G Go e S T ->
    forall H e', preserves_ctx_binds G H -> env_binds_more e e' ->
    @ty_incap mode H Go e' S T).
Proof.
  apply ts_mutind; intros.
  all: try solve [constructor; auto using preserves_ctx_binds_push].
  all: try solve [eapply ty_var_sub; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply ty_var_mut_top; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply subtyp_trans; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply subtyp_sel1; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply subtyp_sel2; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply subtyp_tyq; eauto using typ_equivalence_extend].
  all: try solve [eapply ty_incap_sel; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply subtyp_fun; eauto using preserves_ctx_binds_push].
  all: try solve [eapply subtyp_met; eauto using preserves_ctx_binds_push].
Qed.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DecOpenable DecFreeVar DecSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ L _ _ => label_typ L
      | dec_fld m _ _ => label_fld m
      | dec_met m _ _ _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_or T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_nocap => df
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_fld m T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => comb (comb (collect_typ df f comb TC) (collect_typ df f comb TZ)) (collect_typ df f comb TR)
  end.

Instance TypCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax
  := @collect_typ.

Instance DecCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_dec.

Fixpoint transform_typ (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (T : typ) (n : nat) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (transform_dec f D n)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (f x n) L (f y n)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (transform_typ f T (S n))
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 (S n))
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T (S n)) (transform_typ f U (S n))
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (transform_typ f TC (S n)) (transform_typ f TZ n) (transform_typ f TR (S (S n)))
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive typ_nulary: typ -> Prop :=
| typ_nulary_top: typ_nulary typ_top
| typ_nulary_bot: typ_nulary typ_bot
| typ_nulary_nocap: typ_nulary typ_nocap
.

Inductive typ_andor: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_andor_and: typ_andor typ_and
| typ_andor_or: typ_andor typ_or
.

Notation typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_typ A t1 t2)).

Notation typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_fld A t1 t2)).

Inductive typ_binary: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_binary_and: typ_binary typ_and
| typ_binary_or: typ_binary typ_or
| typ_binary_fun: typ_binary typ_fun
| typ_binary_rcd_typ(A: typ_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A)
| typ_binary_rcd_fld(A: fld_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A)
.

Notation typ_notor B := (forall T U, B <> typ_or T U) (only parsing).

Notation typ_notand T := (forall S1 S2, T <> typ_and S1 S2) (only parsing).
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import SyntaxClasses SyntaxClassProperties SyntaxClassDepth ListSyntaxClasses SyntaxClassLemmas.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Class Collect `(AS : AbstractSyntax B) `(AS': AbstractSyntax A) :=
  collect : forall {C : Type}, C -> (B -> C) -> (C -> C -> C) -> A -> C.

Arguments collect _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ListLikeCollect `{ASB : AbstractSyntax B} `{ASA: AbstractSyntax A}
      {C: Set} `{ASC: AbstractSyntax C} {TL: ToList C A}
      (CBC: Collect ASB ASC) (CBA: Collect ASB ASA) :=
  collect_fold_right_map : forall (C' : Type) (df : C') f comb (a : A),
    collect df f comb a =
    List.fold_right comb df (List.map (collect df f comb) (to_list a)).

Class CollectCompose `(C: Collect B A) :=
  collect_compose :
    forall {C D} (f : C -> D) g comb1 comb2 i,
      (forall x y, f (comb1 x y) = comb2 (f x) (f y)) ->
      f ∘ (collect i g comb1) = collect (f i) (f ∘ g) comb2.

Class CollectReflect `(C: Collect B A) :=
  collect_reflect : forall P p,
    (forall b, (P b) <-> (p b) = true) ->
    forall {bl} a,
      ((collect (Is_true bl) P or a) <-> (collect bl p orb a) = true).

Class FvCollect `(Collect) :=
  fv_collect : fv = collect (\{}) fv (@union var).

Section AboutCollectCompose.

Context `{C: Collect B A}.

Context {CC: CollectCompose C}.

End AboutCollectCompose.

Class Transform `(AS : AbstractSyntax B) `(AS': AbstractSyntax A) :=
  transform : (B -> nat -> B) -> A -> nat -> A.

Arguments transform _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ListLikeTransform `{ASB : AbstractSyntax B} `{ASA: AbstractSyntax A}
      {C: Set} `{ASC: AbstractSyntax C}
      {TL: ToList C A} {FL: OfList C A} {LL: ListLike TL FL}
      (TBC: Transform ASB ASC) (TBA: Transform ASB ASA) :=
  transform_map_f : forall f n a,
    transform f a n = map_f (fun c => transform f c n) a.

Class TransformId `(T: Transform B A) :=
  transform_id : forall x n,
    transform (ignore_second id) x n = x.

Class TransformCompose `(T: Transform B A) :=
  transform_compose : forall f g,
    (transform f) ∘∘ (transform g) = transform (f ∘∘ g).

Class TransformShift `(AS : AbstractSyntax B) `(AS': AbstractSyntax A) (T: Transform AS AS') :=
  transform_shift f X n m: transform f X (n + m) = transform (fun X' n' => f X' (n' + m)) X n.

Class OpenTransform `(Transform) :=
  open_transform : forall n x,
    (open_depth_rec n x) = transform (open_depth_rec n x).

Class SubstTransform `(Transform) :=
  subst_transform : forall x y,
    (ignore_second (subst_var x y)) = transform (ignore_second (subst_var x y)).

Class SealTransform `(Transform B A)  `(Sealable B)  `(Sealable A) :=
  seal_transform : forall n x,
    (seal_depth_rec n x) = transform (seal_depth_rec n x).

Class CollectTransform
      `{ASB : AbstractSyntax B} `{ASA : AbstractSyntax A}
      (C : Collect ASB ASA) (T : Transform ASB ASA) :=
  collect_transform: forall bl p a f g,
    (collect bl p andb a) = true ->
    transform (dec_apply p f g) a = transform f a.

  end.

  intro Hind.
  induction Hind as
    [v T Hbase | v S T HS IHS HT IHT | v S T HS IHS HT IHT
    |v a S T HS IHS HT IHT | v A S T HS IHS HT IHT
    |n A S T HS IHS HT IHT
    |v S T HS IHS HT IHT | n S T HS IHS HT IHT
    |v a1 a2 A H1 H2 |v a1 a2 A H2
    |v T HT IH |n T HT IH
    |v C Z R m HC IHC HZ IHZ HR IHR
    |n C Z R m HC IHC HZ IHZ HR IHR].
  all: try (destruct v as [n|v]; [|exact I]).
  all: try solve [exact I].
  all: cbn [transform_typ transform_dec]; intros e f g Hfg.

  rewrite <- (proj1 typ_transform_identity T 0) at 1 3.
  change (@tyq_typ e

Proof.

    + intros y U Hy. now apply ctx_binds_hide.

Local Definition objctx_fresh_for (H : ctx) (Go : objctx) :=

Local Lemma context_narrows_under_objctx mode e G H Go :
  @context_narrows mode e G H ->
  objctx_fresh_for H Go ->
  @context_narrows mode e (G §§& Go) (H §§& Go).
Proof.

Local Lemma context_narrows_under_method mode e G H Go z r TZ TC :
  @context_narrows mode e G H ->

Local Lemma include_context_types_narrow_top mode G H e x k T U :
  x §# H ->
  @includes_context_types mode e G H ->
  @subtyp mode H objctx_empty e U T ->
  @includes_context_types mode e (G § x / k ~ T) (H § x / k ~ U).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh Hinclude Hsub y B Hbind.
  pose proof (binds_preserved_by_fresh_push k U Hfresh) as Hextension.
  inversion Hbind; subst.
  - eapply ty_var_sub.
    + apply ty_var_var. constructor.
    + eapply (proj1 (proj2 (variable_judgments_extend mode))); eauto.
  - eapply (proj1 (variable_judgments_extend mode)).
    + apply Hinclude. eassumption.
    + exact Hextension.
    + auto.
Qed.

Local Definition method_subtype_components mode G e TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2 :=
  @subtyp mode G objctx_empty e TZ2 TZ1 /\\
  (mode_has_sef mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) /\\
  exists L,
    (forall z, z \\notin L ->
      @subtyp mode (G § z / v_par ~ TZ2) objctx_empty e
        (open z TC2) (open z TC1)) /\\
    (forall z, z \\notin L -> forall r, r <> z -> r \\notin L ->
      @subtyp mode (ctx_met G z TZ2 r TC2) objctx_empty e
        (open_met z r TR1) (open_met z r TR2)).

Local Lemma method_subtype_components_trans
  mode G e C1 Z1 R1 C2 Z2 R2 C3 Z3 R3 :
  @method_subtype_components mode G e C1 Z1 R1 C2 Z2 R2 ->
  @method_subtype_components mode G e C2 Z2 R2 C3 Z3 R3 ->
  @method_subtype_components mode G e C1 Z1 R1 C3 Z3 R3.
Proof.
  intros [Hz21 [Hi21 (L1 & Hc21 & Hr12)]] [Hz32 [Hi32 (L2 & Hc32 & Hr23)]].
  split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption |].
  split; [auto |].
  exists ((L1 \\u L2) \\u ctx_dom G).
  assert (Hpar : forall z, z §# G ->
    @includes_context_types mode e (G § z / v_par ~ Z2) (G § z / v_par ~ Z3)).
  { intros z Hfresh. apply include_context_types_narrow_top; [assumption | | assumption].
    intros x T Hbind. now apply ty_var_var. }
  split.
  - intros z Hz.
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz Hzdom].
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz1 Hz2].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact (Hc32 z Hz2) |].
    eapply (proj1 (proj2 (variable_judgments_narrow mode)));
      [exact (Hc21 z Hz1) | exact (Hpar z Hzdom) | auto].

    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz Hzdom].
    apply notin_union in Hr as [Hr Hrdom].
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz1 Hz2].
    apply notin_union in Hr as [Hr1 Hr2].

Proof.
    intros x T Hbind.
    inversion Hbind; subst; [exact Hreceiver |].
    match goal with H : ctx_binds _ _ (_ § z / v_par ~ TZ) |- _ =>
      inversion H; subst

    apply ty_var_var. apply Hkeep.
    match goal with H : ctx_binds _ _ (ctx_hide G) |- _ => now inversion H end.

Local Lemma include_context_types_narrow_top mode G H e x k T U :

  exists L,

      @subtyp mode (G § z / v_par ~ TZ2) objctx_empty e
        (open z TC2) (open z TC1)) /\
    (forall z, z \notin L -> forall r, r <> z -> r \notin L ->

  mode G e C1 Z1 R1 C2 Z2 R2 C3 Z3 R3 :
  @method_subtype_components mode G e C1 Z1 R1 C2 Z2 R2 ->
  @method_subtype_components mode G e C2 Z2 R2 C3 Z3 R3 ->
  @method_subtype_components mode G e C1 Z1 R1 C3 Z3 R3.
Proof.
  intros [Hz21 [Hi21 (L1 & Hc21 & Hr12)]] [Hz32 [Hi32 (L2 & Hc32 & Hr23)]].
  split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption |].
  split; [auto |].
  exists ((L1 \u L2) \u ctx_dom G).
  assert (Hpar : forall z, z §# G ->
    @includes_context_types mode e (G § z / v_par ~ Z2) (G § z / v_par ~ Z3)).
  { intros z Hfresh. apply include_context_types_narrow_top; [assumption | | assumption].
    intros x T Hbind. now apply ty_var_var. }
  split.
  - intros z Hz.
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz Hzdom].
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz1 Hz2].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact (Hc32 z Hz2) |].
    eapply (proj1 (proj2 (variable_judgments_narrow mode)));
      [exact (Hc21 z Hz1) | exact (Hpar z Hzdom) | auto].
  - intros z Hz r Hneq Hr.
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz Hzdom].
    apply notin_union in Hr as [Hr Hrdom].
    apply notin_union in Hz as [Hz1 Hz2].
    apply notin_union in Hr as [Hr1 Hr2].
    assert (Hrecv : @includes_context_types mode e
      (ctx_met G z Z2 r C2) (ctx_met G z Z3 r C3)).
    { apply include_context_types_narrow_top.
      - simpl. apply notin_union. split; [now apply notin_singleton | exact Hrdom].
      - exact (Hpar z Hzdom).
      - exact (Hc32 z Hz2). }
    eapply subtyp_trans; [|exact (Hr23 z Hz2 r Hneq Hr2)].
    eapply (proj1 (proj2 (variable_judgments_narrow mode)));
      [exact (Hr12 z Hz1 r Hneq Hr1) | exact Hrecv | auto].
Qed.

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Local Lemma typed_call_application_parts mode G Go e t T :

    @ty_var mode G objctx_empty e r (open z C).
Proof.
  intros Htyped Hsef.
  induction Htyped; intros r z meth Heq; try discriminate.
  - inversion Heq; subst. exists TC, TZ, TR. repeat split; auto.
  - auto.

Local Lemma alias_variable_type_exact mode G e x T :
  @ty_var mode G objctx_empty e x T ->
  forall G' e' w,
    mode_incap' mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    preserves_ctx_binds G G' ->
    env_binds_more e e' ->
    @tyq_var e' x w ->
    (forall B, ctx_binds x B G -> @ty_var mode G' objctx_empty e' w B) ->
    @ty_var mode G' objctx_empty e' w T.
Proof.
  intro Htyping.
  induction Htyping as
    [G e x T Hlookup
    | G e x T Hvar IH Hind Hincap
    | G e x T Hvar IH Hind
    | G e x T U Hvar1 IH1 Hvar2 IH2
    | G e x T U Hvar IH Hsub

    intros G' e' w Hmode Hkeep Henv Heq Hbase.
  - now apply Hbase.
  - assert (Hsub : @subtyp mode G' objctx_empty e' (open x T) (open w T)).
    { apply subtyp_tyq. now apply aliased_open_type. }
    apply ty_rec_intro; [|exact Hind|].
    + eapply ty_var_sub; [apply IH; eassumption | exact Hsub].
    + intro Hincapmode. apply ty_incap_nocap; [exact Hmode |].
      eapply subtyp_trans; [|exact Hsub].

  - eapply ty_var_sub with (T := open w T).
    + apply ty_rec_elim; [apply IH; eassumption | exact Hind].
    + apply subtyp_tyq. apply aliased_open_type; [now apply tyq_var_sym | exact Hind].
  - apply ty_var_and; [apply IH1 | apply IH2]; eassumption.
  - eapply ty_var_sub; [apply IH; eassumption |].

  - eapply ty_var_mut_top; [exact Hmut | apply IH; eassumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma alias_variable_same_binding mode G G' e e' x w B T :

| red_refl : forall (C : config),

    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

Inductive avar : Set :=

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
